1.title: 1. Introduction
1.content: Welcome to the services of MYGG, operated by MYGG COMPANY LIMITED and its affiliates hereinafter collectively referred to as "MYGG," "Company," "we," "us," or "our". We are aware of the importance of your personal data privacy rights, and we are committed to complying with the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562, which may be periodically amended, including any announcements, regulations, and/or guidelines issued under the said Act, as well as other relevant laws and regulations (collectively referred to as the "Personal Data Protection Laws"). Therefore, we have developed this Privacy Policy for our customers ("Policy") to provide you with detailed information about the collection, use, disclosure, and/or other processing ("Processing" or "Process") of your personal data by us, for your utmost benefit. We recommend you to read and fully understand this Policy.

2.title: 2. Scope of this Policy
2.content: This Policy applies to you if you are a user of MYGG's services and mobile applications ("Website") (we will refer to games, websites, and other services as specified in our terms of service, collectively referred to as "Services").

3.title: 3. Definitions
3.1: 3.1 "User" refers to a person who has registered an account or has used or accessed our Services (referred to separately and collectively as "User," "you," "your," or "yours").
3.2: 3.2 "Personal Data" means information about an individual that directly or indirectly identifies that person, such as name, identification card number, date of birth, age, occupation, mobile phone number, and residential address.
3.3: 3.3 Any definitions used in this Privacy Policy that are not explicitly defined herein shall have the same meaning as specified in the terms of service of MYGG that are in force.

4.title: 4. Terms and Conditions under this Policy
4.1: 4.1 To use our services, you must register an account with us or access our website. By registering an account or accessing the Company's website, you acknowledge and agree that you accept the practices, rules, and/or policies summarized in this Privacy Policy. Furthermore, you consent to the Company collecting, using, disclosing, and/or processing your personal data in accordance with the provisions and conditions specified in this Policy or as required by law.
4.2: 4.2 If you do not consent to the processing of your personal data as described in the terms and conditions specified in this Privacy Policy, please refrain from accessing our website or games.
4.3: 4.3 In the event of any changes to this Privacy Policy, the Company will notify you. The Company reserves the right to modify this Privacy Policy at any time within the maximum extent permitted by applicable law. Additionally, if you continue to use our services or platforms, including making transactions through our services, after any modifications or changes have been made to the policy following the initial version, you acknowledge and accept the modified Privacy Policy in its entirety.
4.4: 4.4 This Policy applies in conjunction with any declarations, agreements, or consents related to the collection, use, disclosure, and/or processing of your personal data by us unless otherwise explicitly specified. This Policy is effective under any declarations, agreements, or consents.

5.title: 5. Sources of Personal Data

1.title: 5.1 Collected directly from you
1.sub_title: The Company may receive your personal data in the following situations:
1.1: (1) When you submit any forms, including but not limited to application forms or other forms related to any of our products or services, regardless of the format you use.
1.2: (2) When you enter into any agreements or provide documents or other information to us or use our products or services.
1.3: (3) When you contact us, such as through telephone calls (which may be recorded), letters, faxes, face-to-face meetings, social media, and emails, including when you interact with our customer service agents.
1.4: (4) When you use our services through our electronic systems or have any interactions with us through our games or website, including but not limited to receiving the aforementioned information through cookies when you use or access our games or website.
1.5: (5) When you voluntarily disclose any information to us through actions on your phone, such as by granting permissions through mobile applications or our website.
1.6: (6) When you link your MYGG account to your online social media accounts (as defined below) or other user accounts, or use other social media features under the policies of those respective social media feature providers.
1.7: (7) When you conduct transactions through our games or website (when mandatory) or with any authorized payment service providers that we have approved.
1.8: (8) When you provide compliments or submit complaints to us.
1.9: (9) When you register for competitions, games, or specific gaming events.
1.11: (11) When you provide your personal information to us for any reason.

5.text: In these cases mentioned above, the Company may not necessarily collect, use, process, or access all of your complete and comprehensive data. The data specified is merely a partial example of general personal data about you that may be collected by the Company.

6.title: 6. Other Data Collection
6.1: 6.1 Your data may be collected from the servers of our company's website when you use our services as usual. This includes, but is not limited to, the Internet Protocol Address (IP Address) of the device used to identify your computer connected to the network, the operating system of your computer/device, mobile phone type, characteristics of your mobile phone, unique device identifiers (UDID) or Mobile Equipment ID (MEID) for your mobile phone devices, website references (if any), pages you visit on the website, and the time of your visits. In some cases, our company may also receive data through "cookies" (which can be disabled in your browser settings), a system that helps websites remember your latest visits. If you have logged in, this data will be linked to your personal account. Additionally, the data includes non-personally identifiable statistics to help us understand how visitors use our games and website.
6.2: 6.2 In the case of mobile applications, we may collect data related to the location on your mobile phone device, which is associated with the use of technologies such as Global Positioning System (GPS) or Wi-Fi. In this regard, we may collect, disclose, and/or use such data for one or more purposes, including but not limited to providing Location-Based Services (LBS) that you requested or sending location-related content to you based on your location. Moreover, you may grant permission for sharing your location with other users as part of the services under the mobile application on your mobile phone. You have the right to withdraw your consent for us to possess this data on your location through the settings on your device. If you have any questions about how to disable the location services on your mobile phone device, please contact your mobile phone service provider or device manufacturer.
6.3: 6.3 In the event that you view pages or content on our website or mobile applications, all data will be transmitted to us. This includes, but is not limited to, your IP address, information about your operating system, data related to the content, advertisements viewed, and/or software installed, as well as the time of your visits.

7.title: 7. What Personal Data will MYGG Collect?

1.title: 7.1 MYGG may collect the following Personal Data, including but not limited to:
1.4: (4) Transactional data, including banking information and payment data (when mandatory and under applicable laws).
1.5: (5) Conversations and data related to any individuals or accounts you contact.
1.6: (6) Gender, age, and/or date of birth.
1.7: (7) Data sent by any devices connected to our services.
1.8: (8) Images, audio, or video recordings provided by you through our services.
1.10: (10) Identity data issued by government agencies or other data provided to us (when mandatory).
1.11: (11) Communication and marketing data, such as your preferences for receiving marketing materials, communication channels you are interested in, and communication history with us and our service providers.
1.12: (12) Data from survey responses, tournament-related data, or any other data provided to us.
1.13: (13) Any other data you provide when registering or using our services, including data shared through your social media accounts ("Social Media Accounts"), transaction and usage data, activity-related data, transaction history, service usage data, and data related to your interactions with advertisements and content.

7.2: 7.2 You agree not to submit inaccurate or deceptive information to us, and you agree to notify us of any inaccuracies or changes in such data. We reserve the sole right to request additional documentation to verify the details of the information you provide to us under applicable laws.
7.3: 7.3 If you register as a user of our services using your social media account or link your account with your social media account, or use MYGG's Social Media Features, we may access information about you that you have prepared for your social media service provider voluntarily, following their respective policies. Additionally, we may manage, store, and use such personal data according to the policies in all cases.
7.4: 7.4 If you do not wish for us to collect or process the mentioned data/personal information, you can withdraw your consent at any time by notifying our Data Protection Officer in writing. Additional information regarding account cancellation can be found in the section below titled "How to Opt-out, Delete, Request Access, or Correct Your Provided Data.
7.text: Please note that withdrawing your consent or providing data may affect your use of our services

8.title: 8. Cookies
8.1: 8.1 We, or third parties acting on our behalf, including our advertising partners, may use "cookies" or other similar features occasionally to collect or share information about your usage of our services. These features help us improve our website, games, and services and enable us to introduce new services and features. They also assist us and our advertising partners in providing content relevant to your interests, including advertising tailored to customers under applicable laws. "Cookies" are unique identifiers that we send to your computer or mobile device, which store information about your computer or device's usage and the time and method of accessing our services or websites, the number of users, and other activities within our websites and games. We may link cookie data with your personal information. Furthermore, cookies may be linked to data about the items you have selected for purchase or the games you have played, and this data may be used to track your shopping cart and present content that suits your interests or to allow our advertising partners to provide advertisements through our services or on various internet sites. Additionally, these cookies help us monitor the usage of our services related to the relevant features.
8.2: 8.2 You can reject the use of cookies or web beacons by adjusting your browser or device settings according to your preferences or interests. However, please note that if you do so, you may not be able to fully utilize various functionalities of our websites, games, or services.
8.3: 8.3 You can opt-out of interest-based advertising through certain mobile applications by following instructions provided for Android and iOS operating systems.

9.title: 9. How will we use the information you provide to us?

1.title: 9.1 We may collect, use, disclose, and/or process your personal information for one or more of the following purposes:
1.1: (1) To consider and/or process your requests/transactions with us or transactions or communications with third parties through our services.
1.2: (2) To manage, operate, deliver, and/or administer your use of and access to our services and websites and games, including but not limited to managing your preferences.
1.3: (3) To respond to, process, and/or complete your requests for products or services and to notify you of account-related issues or abnormalities.
1.4: (4) To enforce our terms of service or any applicable user agreements.
1.5: (5) To protect the safety, privacy, property, and rights of others.
1.6: (6) For identity verification and/or authentication purposes.
1.7: (7) To maintain, manage, and improve software updates and/or other updates, support our services, which includes troubleshooting, reporting, or handling any issues (e.g., responding to error reports or crash reports) that may be necessary to ensure the smooth operation of our games and/or services.
1.8: (8) To manage and/or facilitate customer relations or to carry out your instructions or respond to inquiries received from (or purported to be from) you or on your behalf.
1.9: (9) To contact you or communicate with you through voice, text, and/or facsimile communications, email, and/or postal mail or other means, for the purpose of managing and/or administering your relationship with us or your use of our services, including but not limited to communicating information relating to the supervision of our services. In this regard, you acknowledge and agree that such communications by us may be considered as correspondence, documents, or notifications sent to you by post, and that such communications may include personal information about you for the purpose of delivery, such as addressing on envelopes/parcels for postal services.
1.10: (10) To allow other users to contact or connect with you and to notify you when other users have sent private messages to you or posted comments for you in games or on websites.
1.11: (11) To conduct research, analysis, and development of various activities (including but not limited to data analysis, surveys, product and service development, and/or analysis of your interests or behaviors) to analyze the usage of our services, recommend products and/or services based on your interests, improve our services or products, and/or promote your customer experience.
1.12: (12) For advertising, verification, and various surveys (through offline and online surveys on platforms of other individuals, such as conducting surveys through Google Forms) to assess the size and composition of our target audience and conduct studies and analysis regarding the customer experience received from MYGG services.
1.13: (13) For marketing and advertising purposes for marketing promotion activities when permissible under applicable law, such as recommending products and/or services based on your interests, communicating marketing information through various methods and formats (including email or SMS) related to marketing information and sales promotions, including but not limited to products and/or services of any other person that MYGG may collaborate with or have agreements with, whether they currently exist or will exist in the future. You can unsubscribe from receiving marketing information at any time by selecting the unsubscribe function available in electronic marketing materials. Additionally, we may use your information to contact you for sending newsletters or marketing materials from us and our affiliated companies.
1.14: (14) To respond to legal processes or comply with or as required by any applicable law, government regulations, or binding authority of any relevant jurisdiction, including but not limited to complying with regulations for disclosures under any applicable law that binds MYGG or related companies.
1.15: (15) To generate statistics and conduct research for internal and legal reporting purposes, and/or as required by any applicable law or regulation governing record retention.
1.16: (16) To conduct due diligence or screening activities, including but not limited to verifying records that comply with legal obligations or processes related to risk management that may be required by law or determined by us.
1.17: (17) To verify our service accounts or MYGG's business.
1.18: (18) To prevent or investigate violations or suspected violations of our service terms and conditions, fraud, illegal activities, neglect, or misconduct related to the use of our services or any other matters arising from your relationship with us.
1.19: (19) To store data, regardless of the type of personal data, for the purpose of data recovery or other purposes for which personal data is entitled under the law.
1.20: (20) To manage and/or facilitate business transactions or potential business transactions involving MYGG as a participant, or simply related to affiliated companies or companies within MYGG's group, or more, which may include organizations external to the transaction. The term 'business transactions' refers to purchases, sales, leases, mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, transfers, or financial arrangements of an organization or part of an organization, or any and all business activities or assets of an organization.
1.21: (21) To assess qualifications and/or send applications or registrations to participate in any games, competitions, activities, or tournaments, and to deliver prizes to you when applicable.
1.22: (21) Other purposes that can be carried out under applicable law, which we will inform you of and seek your consent (hereinafter referred to as "purposes").

2.title: 9.2 You acknowledge, agree, and consent that MYGG may access, retain, and disclose information in your user account, including 'Content,' when required to do so by law, court orders, or orders from any government authority with jurisdiction over MYGG, or in good faith belief that such actions are necessary to:
2.2: (2) Comply with orders from any government authority with jurisdiction over MYGG.
2.3: (3) Enforce the terms of service and this privacy policy.
2.4: (4) Respond to any claims, whether by coercion or in truth, made against MYGG, or to any claims that the 'Content' violates the rights of any other individual.
2.5: (5) Respond to your customer service requests.
2.6: (6) Protect the rights and ensure the safety of MYGG's property, users, and/or the public.

9.3: 9.3 We may collect, use, disclose, or process your personal data based on the prevailing circumstances at that time. The purposes mentioned above may not be exhaustive. Nevertheless, we will inform you of any other purposes to seek your consent, except for data processing related to which we are authorized to do so by applicable data protection laws.

10.title: 10. How does MYGG protect and retain customer data?
10.1: 10.1 We have implemented various security measures and operational controls to ensure the security of your personal data within our system. Customer data is stored in a secure network accessible by a limited number of authorized personnel with special access privileges. However, we have to inform you that we cannot guarantee the complete security of your personal data.

2.title: 10.2 We will retain your personal data in accordance with data protection laws and other relevant laws. We will delete or unlink your personal data when it is deemed appropriate due to the following reasons:
2.1: (1) There is no longer a legal or business purpose to collect or store such personal data.
2.2: (2) There is no legitimate reason to retain your personal data. If you cease to use our services or revoke the authorization to use your website, game, and/or service, we may still continue to collect, use, and/or disclose your personal data as per this privacy policy and our obligations under applicable data protection laws. We may securely dispose of your personal data without prior notice.

11.title: 11. Does MYGG disclose the data collected from visitors to third parties?

1.title: 11.1 In the course of our business, we may need to disclose your personal data to external service providers, agents, and/or companies within our group or related companies, as well as other third parties, whether located within or outside the country, for one or more purposes as mentioned above. These third parties may process your personal data on behalf of us or for their own purposes, as stated above. These third parties include, but are not limited to:
1.1: (1) Our subsidiaries, affiliated companies, and related companies;
1.2: (2) Other users of our services who are relevant to your use of our services and for one or more "purposes";
1.3: (3) Contractors, agents, service providers, and other external parties that support our business. > These parties include, but are not limited to, courier companies, game developers partnering with us, financial or payment service providers, advertising and marketing agencies, telecommunication companies, IT companies, and data centers;
1.4: (4) Government agencies and regulatory authorities that have control and oversight authority over MYGG, or as authorized as specified in section 9.2;
1.5: (5) Buyers or other successors in case of business mergers, company divestitures, corporate restructuring, business closures, or other sales or transfers of part or all of MYGG. This includes business operations or part thereof, liquidation, accounting treatment, or similar processes, or changes in any of our services. Personal data held by MYGG related to our users may be transferred as part of the transfer of assets to or for the benefit of the contracting party in the business transaction involving MYGG or companies within the group or related companies or any company conducting transactions with us.
1.6: (6) Third parties that have received disclosures of data from us for one or more purposes may collect and process your personal data for one or more purposes as mentioned above.

11.2: 11.2 We may disclose information about your gameplay history and/or logs that show access to games and IP addresses to third parties. Additionally, we may share statistical and demographic data about our users and their service usage with advertising partners and other parties for advertising, customer tracking, and/or programming purposes, as permitted by applicable laws.
11.3: 11.3 You may export your user activity feed as an RSS feed, which other users can subscribe to. This feed may include information about your gameplay, game installations, connections with other users, and other activity-related data in your account. This feed will be made available on websites or games in accordance with the provisions mentioned above and under applicable laws. We may use your personal data under legally applicable data processing bases, which may include one or more bases related to the purposes stated in section 9.1 above. These bases may include legal obligations, contractual obligations with you, our legitimate interests while considering the impact on your rights regarding data protection, and any other purposes for which you have given your consent, which we may occasionally seek when necessary or in relation to any legal complaints.
11.4: 11.4 To avoid any doubts, in cases where data protection laws or other relevant laws permit us to collect, use, or disclose your personal data without your consent, such authorization under the law will continue to be valid under the conditions and timeframes specified by the law.
11.5: 11.5 Third parties may unlawfully intercept or access personal data transmitted or stored on the website. Technology may have errors or not function as expected, and unauthorized individuals may access, breach, or misuse data without any fault on our part. However, we will implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal data as required by data protection laws. Nevertheless, we cannot provide complete security guarantees, including but not limited to instances of unauthorized disclosures resulting from sophisticated and malicious hacking activities beyond our control.

12.title: 12. Data Concerning Children
12.1: 12.1 This service is not intended for children under the age of 13. We will not collect or retain any personally identifiable information or non-personal information that can identify or confirm the identity of individuals under the age of 13, or any part of our website, games, or other services visible to them. Therefore, parents or legal guardians, according to the law, are advised to ensure that children under their guardianship do not provide MYGG with personal information.
12.text: Please refer to MYGG's terms of service for further details. If you knowingly provide MYGG with personal information of a child under the age of 13 under your guardianship, you are deemed to have consented to the processing of the personal data of that child, and your agreement and acceptance will be subject to the conditions specified in this privacy policy on behalf of that child. In case you do not consent to the processing of personal data of a child under the age of 13 under your guardianship, please contact our data protection officer. Nevertheless, we will close accounts used by such children and will remove and/or delete the personal data submitted by them without consent from their parents or legal guardians, or as required by applicable law.

13.title: 13. Data Collected by Third Parties
13.1: 13.1 Our website and games use Google Analytics, a web analytics service provided by Google Inc. ("Google"). Google Analytics uses cookies, which are text files placed on your device to help analyze how users use our services. The information generated by cookies about your use of the services or your device (including your IP address) is sent to and stored by Google on servers in the United States. Google will use this information for the purpose of evaluating your use of our services, compiling reports on website activity for website operators, and providing other services relating to website activity and internet usage. Google may also transfer this information to third parties as required by law or when third parties process data on behalf of Google. Google will not associate your IP address with any other data held by Google.
13.2: 13.2 In some cases, we and third parties may allow downloaded applications or software to access and operate your device for your use or via these applications. These applications may access and review your information separately, and third parties may verify your identity information, such as your name, user ID, IP address, information about games you play during certain periods, and cookies that you may have installed or installed by third-party software applications or websites. Additionally, these applications may directly request additional information from you. The products or services of third parties available through these applications are not owned or controlled by MYGG. We recommend that you read the terms and other agreements provided by such third parties on their websites or elsewhere.

14.title: 14. Reserved Rights Regarding Security and Third-Party Websites
14.1: 14.1 We hereby reserve the right not to guarantee the security of personal data and/or other data that you provide to third-party websites. We would like to inform you that we employ various security measures to maintain the security of data. These measures aim to safeguard your personal data under our possession or control. Consequently, your personal data will be stored within a secure network accessible only by individuals with special access rights to such systems. We also assure you that we take necessary steps to keep your personal data confidential. When you place an order or access your personal data, we will transfer the information to a secure server. All sensitive information or data that you provide will be encrypted in our database, and access to such data will be limited as mentioned above.
14.2: 14.2 We are fully aware of the importance of the privacy rights of your personal data. Therefore, for efficient operations, we may use third-party websites for certain activities or games. Additionally, we may engage in co-branding or other partnerships to offer e-commerce, services, and other features to our visitors. However, these linked websites have separate and independent privacy policies and security practices. While some third-party partners may share data collected through our website or games, this information may not be transmitted back to us. Consequently, we do not hold any responsibility or liability for the content, security readiness (or lack thereof), and activities of these linked websites. They are provided for your convenience, and your use of these linked websites is at your own risk. Nevertheless, we strive to protect the integrity of our website and any links placed within each game and website. Therefore, we welcome

15.title: 15. Reserved Rights Regarding Security and Third-Party Websites
15.1: 15.1 Your personal data and/or other data may be sent, stored, or processed outside your country. MYGG may transfer your data to foreign countries under the laws governing personal data protection. By agreeing to this privacy policy, you are considered to consent to the transmission of your data to any countries where the companies within our group, our development partners, servers, and/or databases are located. In most cases, your personal data will be processed in Singapore, where our central databases and servers operate. Due to varying regulations in each country's jurisdiction regarding data protection, we will ensure adequate protection measures are in place to safeguard your data.
15.2: 15.2 If you are a user in India, your personal data will be processed and stored in our servers located in India or Singapore. MYGG may transfer your data to foreign countries under the laws governing personal data protection, and you consent to such transfer and processing of your data.
15.3: 15.3 For details on the transfer of personal data outside the European Union (EU) and personal data and/or data related to users in EU member states, please refer to the section titled "Additional Terms for Users in EU Member States" only.

16.title: 16. Withdrawal of Consent
16.1: 16.1 You have the right to withdraw your consent for the collection, use, and/or disclosure or request the deletion of your personal data in our possession or under our control. You can do so by informing our data protection officer in Thailand at support@mygg-game.com or sending an email to the relevant email address listed in the table below. We will process your request in accordance with this privacy policy and our obligations under the applicable data protection and privacy laws.
16.2: 16.2 Please note that withdrawing your consent as mentioned above may result in us being unable to continue providing services to you. In such cases, we may have to terminate our services and/or contracts with you.

17.title: 17. Accessing or Correcting Personal Data
17.1: 17.1 If you have an account with us, you may access and/or correct the accuracy of the personal data currently held or controlled by us through the account settings or dashboard on the website or game.  If you do not have an account with us, you may request access and/or correction of the accuracy of the personal data currently held or controlled by us by submitting a written request to our data protection officer in Thailand at support@mygg-game.com or to the relevant email address provided in the table below. Please note that you will need to provide sufficient information for us to verify your identity to process your request. Therefore, kindly send your request as a written letter to us via email.
17.2: 17.2 Under applicable law, we may charge a reasonable fee for processing and handling your access requests to your personal data. If we decide to charge a fee, we will send an estimate of the fee to you in writing. Please note that we are not obligated to respond to or process your access request until you agree to pay the fee.
17.3: 17.3 We reserve the right to refuse to correct the accuracy of your personal data as required by the applicable data protection laws and may grant organizations the right to refuse to correct the accuracy of personal data in certain circumstances.

18.title: 18. User Rights in EU Member States

1.title: 18.1 This section is an additional provision for users residing in EU member states. The following provisions apply solely to users residing in EU member states. In case of any inconsistency between these provisions and any other provisions in this privacy policy, these provisions shall prevail.
18.1.1 Data Transfers
1.text: You have the right to receive your personal data provided to us, and we will store such data with your consent, in a commonly used and machine-readable format. You also have the right to request the transfer of such personal data to another party. If you wish to have us transfer your personal data to another person, please ensure that you have informed that person, and please note that we will only transfer the data if it is technically feasible to do so. We are not responsible for the security of the data or the processing of personal data after it has been transferred to another person, and we may not disclose certain personal data if it would violate the rights of others (e.g., if providing your personal data, which we hold, would disclose information about other individuals).

2.title: 18.1.2 Request for Data Deletion
2.sub_title: You have the right to request us to delete your personal data held by us in the following cases:
2.1: (1) If you believe that we no longer need to retain your personal data.
2.2: (2) If we process your personal data based on your consent, and you wish to withdraw that consent, and there are no other legal grounds for us to process the data further.
2.3: (3) If we process your personal data for legitimate interests under our laws, and you object to such processing. Please provide the reasons for your objection to enable us to assess whether the processing and storage of the data are overridden by our interests.
2.4: (4) If you do not want us to use your personal data held by us for sending promotional materials, special offers, marketing information, and sweepstakes.
2.5: (5) If you believe that your personal data held by us is being used in a manner that violates the law.
2.text: Please provide as much information as possible in your request to enable us to determine whether you have the right to request the deletion of the data. However, please note that we may continue to retain your personal data if there are valid legal reasons, such as the exercise or defense of legal claims, compliance with legal obligations, or the exercise of the right to freedom of expression. We will inform you if there are such cases. Please be aware that after the deletion of your personal data, we may not be able to provide you with the same level of service as before, and we may not be aware of your preferences or choices, and as such, we may not be able to continue providing services to you.

3.title: 18.1.3 Retention of Personal Data
3.text: We may retain your personal data for as long as necessary to provide services or fulfill product provisions to you, as required by law, or as permitted by relevant laws, such as tax and accounting laws or to exercise or defend legal claims. In cases where you request data deletion and we find your request to be valid, we will proceed to delete your personal data within thirty (30) days from the date of receiving your request or notify you if an extension is required.

4.title: 18.1.4 Objection to Data Collection and Targeted Marketing
4.text: We may retain your personal data for as long as necessary to provide services or fulfill product provisions to you, as required by law, or as permitted by relevant laws, such as tax and accounting laws or to exercise or defend legal claims. In cases where you request data deletion and we find your request to be valid, we will proceed to delete your personal data within thirty (30) days from the date of receiving your request or notify you if an extension is required.

5.title: 18.1.5 Limitation of Data Processing for Storage Purposes Only
5.sub_title: You have the right to request us to limit the processing of your personal data for storage purposes only when:
5.1: (1) You believe that the personal data is inaccurate. In this case, we need time to verify whether the data is indeed inaccurate as you stated.
5.2: (2) We wish to delete the personal data, but you request us to retain it.
5.3: (3) We wish to delete the personal data because there is no longer a need to use it, but you request us to keep it as evidence or for legal claims.
5.4: (4) You object to the processing of your personal data for legitimate interests under our laws, and you request us to stop processing the data while we consider whether there are overriding interests in processing and storing the data.

6.title: 18.1.6 Transferring Personal Data Outside the EU
6.text: Your personal data may be transferred outside the EU. We will ensure that the recipients of your personal data have adequate confidentiality obligations, and we will implement measures such as appropriate contractual terms to ensure that the recipients protect and maintain the confidentiality of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

7.title: 18.1.7 Data Concerning Children
7.text: This service is not intended for children under the age of 16 residing in the EU. We will not collect or store any personal data, including personally identifiable information, from children under the age of 16 residing in the EU, even if it is not personal data from children under the age of 16 residing in the EU or any part of our website, game, or other services used by children under the age of 16 residing in the EU. We will close accounts used by such children and will remove and/or delete personal data that we believe has been provided by children under the age of 16 residing in the EU. If you wish to exercise these rights, please contact us as specified below by sending an email to our officer at support@mygg-game.com. We will process your request under applicable law to protect your privacy. We may need to verify your identity before processing your request. If you are a resident of California, you have the right to opt-out of having your personal information sold by us under the CCPA.
